[USER] User inquired about an example of a decentralized self-organizing algorithm to predict ALCOA non-compliance in the pharmaceutical industry.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided an example of a decentralized self-organizing algorithm called federated learning, which allows multiple devices to train a shared model without sharing data.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] In federated learning, each device trains a local model using its own data and shares model updates with a central server, which aggregates the updates to improve the shared model.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant explained that this method keeps data decentralized and private while increasing accuracy in predicting ALCOA non-compliance.
